license_required.quote: No public accounting firm located in this state shall engage in the practice of public accounting in this state unless it registers with the accountancy board

issuing_authority.quote: The accountancy board shall grant the certificate of "certified public accountant" to any person who satisfies the following requirements

age_minimum.quote: The person has attained the age of eighteen years.

degree_required.value: Baccalaureate, master's, or higher degree with accounting concentration
degree_required.quote: Graduation with a baccalaureate, master's, or higher degree. The board by rule shall require any subjects that it considers appropriate. The total educational program shall include an accounting concentration with related courses in other areas of business administration

required.quote: acquisition of one year of experience satisfactory to the board in any of the following: (i) A public accounting firm; (ii) Government; (iii) Business; (iv) Academia.

duration.quote: The experience requirement for a candidate who satisfies the educational requirements under division (A)(2)(a) of this section by obtaining a baccalaureate degree is two years of the experience described in division (A)(2)(b) of this section.

kind.value: public accounting, government, business, or academia experience
kind.quote: acquisition of one year of experience satisfactory to the board in any of the following: (i) A public accounting firm; (ii) Government; (iii) Business; (iv) Academia.

exams.name: Uniform CPA Examination
exams.notes: Board may use all or parts of the AICPA uniform CPA examination and advisory grading service
exams.quote: The person has passed an examination that is administered in the manner and that covers the subjects that the board prescribes by rule... the board shall ensure to the extent possible that the examination, the examination process, and the examination's passing standard are uniform with the examinations, examination processes, and examination passing standards of all other states and may provide for the use of all or parts of the uniform certified public accountant examination and advisory grading service of the American institute of certified public accountants.

interval_years.quote: All Ohio permits shall expire on the last day of December of the year assigned by the board and, subject to division (H)(1) of this section, shall be renewed triennially for a period of three years

required.quote: the board may adopt rules requiring that each applicant for an Ohio permit shall have demonstrated to the satisfaction of the board that the applicant has maintained a high level of professional competence by the completion of programs of continuing education satisfactory to the board

hours_per_period.quote: The board shall not require more than one hundred twenty hours of those programs over any three-year period for applicants possessing an Ohio permit.

period_years.quote: The board shall not require more than one hundred twenty hours of those programs over any three-year period for applicants possessing an Ohio permit.

available.quote: The board shall issue a certificate as a "certified public accountant" in accordance with Chapter 4796. of the Revised Code to a person if either of the following applies: (1) The person holds a certificate as a certified public accountant in another state.

requirements.value: Person holds a valid CPA certificate in another state, or has satisfactory work experience, government certification, or private certification in a state that does not issue that certificate
requirements.quote: The board shall issue a certificate as a "certified public accountant" in accordance with Chapter 4796. of the Revised Code to a person if either of the following applies: (1) The person holds a certificate as a certified public accountant in another state. (2) The person has satisfactory work experience, a government certification, or a private certification as described in that chapter as a certified public accountant in a state that does not issue that certificate.

regulatory_model.quote: no individual shall assume or use the title or designation "certified public accountant"... unless the individual holds a CPA certificate and holds an Ohio permit

title_protection.quote: no individual shall assume or use the title or designation "certified public accountant," "certified accountant," "chartered accountant," "enrolled accountant," "licensed accountant," or "registered accountant," or any other title or designation likely to be confused with "certified public accountant," or any of the abbreviations "CPA," "PA," "CA," "EA," "LA," or "RA," or similar abbreviations likely to be confused with "CPA," ... unless the individual holds a CPA certificate and holds an Ohio permit.

scope_protection.quote: No individual shall sign, affix, or associate the individual's name or any trade or assumed name used by the individual in the individual's profession or business to any attest report with any wording indicating that the individual is an accountant or auditor... unless the individual holds an Ohio permit.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud or deceit in obtaining a firm registration, CPA certificate, PA registration, Ohio permit, or Ohio registration
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraud or deceit in obtaining a firm registration or in obtaining a CPA certificate, a PA registration, an Ohio permit, or an Ohio registration

disciplinary_grounds.description: Dishonesty, fraud, or gross negligence in the practice of public accounting
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Dishonesty, fraud, or gross negligence in the practice of public accounting

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any of the provisions of section 4701.14 (unauthorized practice provisions)
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of any of the provisions of section 4701.14 of the Revised Code

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of a rule of professional conduct promulgated by the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of a rule of professional conduct promulgated by the board under the authority granted by this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony under the laws of any state or of the United States
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of a felony under the laws of any state or of the United States

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of any crime involving dishonesty or fraud under the laws of any state or the United States
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of any crime, an element of which is dishonesty or fraud, under the laws of any state or of the United States

disciplinary_grounds.description: Cancellation, revocation, suspension, or refusal to renew authority to practice as a CPA, PA, or public accounting firm by any other state
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Cancellation, revocation, suspension, or refusal to renew authority to practice as a certified public accountant, a public accountant, or a public accounting firm by any other state, for any cause other than failure to pay registration fees in that other state

disciplinary_grounds.description: Suspension or revocation of the right to practice before any state or federal agency
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Suspension or revocation of the right to practice before any state or federal agency

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure of a CPA certificate or PA registration holder to obtain an Ohio permit or Ohio registration, or failure of a public accounting firm to obtain a firm registration
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure of a holder of a CPA certificate or PA registration to obtain an Ohio permit or an Ohio registration, or the failure of a public accounting firm to obtain a firm registration

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conduct discreditable to the public accounting profession or to the holder of an Ohio permit, Ohio registration, or foreign certificate
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conduct discreditable to the public accounting profession or to the holder of an Ohio permit, Ohio registration, or foreign certificate

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure of a public accounting firm to comply with the firm registration requirements of section 4701.04
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure of a public accounting firm to comply with section 4701.04 of the Revised Code.

definition_quote.value: performing or offering to perform any engagement that will result in the issuance of an attest report and, with respect to a person who holds a CPA certificate, PA registration, foreign certificate, or firm registration, any other services involving the use of accounting or auditing skills as established by rules adopted by the accountancy board
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of public accounting" means performing or offering to perform any engagement that will result in the issuance of an attest report and, with respect to a person who holds a CPA certificate, PA registration, foreign certificate, or firm registration, any other services involving the use of accounting or auditing skills as established by rules adopted by the accountancy board.

methods_authorized.quote: performing or offering to perform any engagement that will result in the issuance of an attest report and... any other services involving the use of accounting or auditing skills

attest_services_types.quote: "Attest report" means an opinion report, review report, compilation report, examination report, agreed-upon procedures report, or any similar report prepared in accordance with standards established by the American institute of certified public accountants with respect to a financial statement or other financial information.

compilation_services_authorized.quote: "Compilation report" means any compilation report on a financial statement that is issued with respect to financial information of a nonpublic entity in accordance with statements on standards for accounting and review services as promulgated by the American institute of certified public accountants.

practice_privilege_no_notice_required.quote: an individual whose principal place of business is not in this state shall have all of the privileges of a holder of a CPA certificate and an Ohio permit without the need to obtain a CPA certificate and an Ohio permit if all of the following apply

value: personal and subject matter jurisdiction of the accountancy board
all practice and disciplinary provisions of this chapter and the accountancy board's rules
appointment of the board that issued the individual's foreign certificate as the individual's agent upon whom process may be served
practice_privilege_consent_conditions.quote: Any individual exercising the privilege afforded under division (I)(1) of this section hereby consents and is subject, as a condition of the grant of the privilege, to all of the following: (a) The personal and subject matter jurisdiction of the accountancy board; (b) All practice and disciplinary provisions of this chapter and the accountancy board's rules; (c) The appointment of the board that issued the individual's foreign certificate as the individual's agent upon whom process may be served in any action or proceeding by the accountancy board against the individual.

attest_services_require_firm_permit.quote: No person shall sign, affix, or associate the name of a partnership, limited liability company, professional association, corporation-for-profit, or other business organization not addressed in this section to any attest report... unless the partnership, limited liability company, professional association, corporation-for-profit, or other business organization is a registered firm.

firm_majority_cpa_ownership_required.quote: more than fifty per cent of the total equity interest or shares in the public accounting firm shall be owned by individuals who hold an Ohio permit or a foreign certificate.

nonlicensee_firm_owners_permitted.quote: A person who does not hold an Ohio permit or a foreign certificate may own an equity interest or shares in a public accounting firm if all of the following conditions are met

peer_review_required_for_firm_renewal.quote: As a condition for initial or renewal registration of a public accounting firm on and after January 1, 1993, the board, by rule, shall require that each public accounting firm undergo a peer review

peer_review_max_frequency_years.quote: All public accounting firms shall renew their registration triennially.

peer_review_records_privileged.quote: The proceedings, records, and work papers of any reviewer, including board members and review committee members, involved in the peer review process are privileged and not subject to discovery, subpoena, or other means of legal process and may not be introduced into evidence.

inactive_license_status_available.quote: The accountancy board may issue Ohio registrations to holders of the CPA certificate and the PA registration who are not engaged in the practice of public accounting.

retired_license_status_available.quote: The board by rule may exempt persons from the requirement of holding an Ohio permit or Ohio registration for specified reasons, including, but not limited to, retirement, health reasons, military service, foreign residency, or other just cause.

attest_report_signer_competency_requirem.quote: Each individual in a public accounting firm who signs any attest report issued from an office of the public accounting firm located in this state shall hold an Ohio permit.

foreign_accountant_practice_exception.quote: the accountancy board may, in its discretion, upon the payment of a fee not to exceed seventy-five dollars, permit the registration of any person who is the holder of a certificate, license, or degree in a foreign country constituting a recognized qualification for the practice of public accounting in such country. A person so registered shall use only the title under which the person is generally known in the person's own country, followed by the name of the country from which the person received the person's certificate, license, or degree.

single_act_evidence_sufficient.quote: In any action, evidence of the commission of a single act prohibited by this section shall be sufficient to justify an injunction or a conviction without evidence of a general course of conduct.

firm_permit_required_for_attest_services.quote: No public accounting firm located in this state shall engage in the practice of public accounting in this state unless it registers with the accountancy board and pays a registration fee set by the board.

accounting_practitioner_tier.quote: The accountancy board shall register as a public accountant any person who meets all the following requirements
